notes.title: Game Update 1.1
notes.content:
I updated the game a little:

[list]
[*] Changed the save system (Old one was causing music to not play when loading under certain conditions)
[*] Made combat victory and combat start music lower.
[*] Fixed an asset error in post scene (it was looking for a sound file that didn't exist).
[/list]
None of this should affect existing saves.

Also, I went encrypted all the files, but I put a gallery folder in the root folder of the install directory. This gallery folder has all the Image Gallery images so you don't have to print screen or something if you want to save them. I figured I'd just make it easier.


Take care and thanks for supporting me!

- Apple.

notes.title: Major game update to Sir Stretchalot - "The Wenches in the Well"
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

For the last few weeks I've been working on a huge update for this game, which is now called Sir Stretchalot - "The Wenches in the Well".

The original game had 6.8k words of dialogue. I added on another 2k to that . . . and then I added a whole new epilogue after the main game that is 8.8k on its own.

Everything got an overhaul. All the cutscenes were polished. All the lewd scenes have animations and are so much better and more in-depth than before (they sucked before). Combat is a bit of a challenge now and doesn't use backgrounds that don't match the game. There's some skills to use as well.

Sir Stretchalot himself has a character bust that shows and he also got a complete re-design.

There's new music and sound effects. There's an Image Gallery now + a post-game where you can replay the lewd scenes and their animations as much as you want.

The Epilogue has a whole new hottie to stretch, and, depending on your decisions, two different ways that stretching can play out.

Oh, and there's Steam achievements to unlock now!

Here's a full list of patch notes, which should include everything:

[list]
[*] Expanded the story to include an epilogue of sorts
[*] Added 1 new sex scene with a new hottie
[*] Added several new lewd images, all of which feature looping animations that you can control
[*] Added a post-game (Can’t do much here, but it is there to allow you to access the Image Gallery and revisit sex scenes whenever you like)
[*] Greatly expanded all the original sex scenes to include looping animations that you can control + added more dialogue during these scenes.
[*] Added an Image Gallery where you can view unlocked lewd illustrations
[*] Added Steam Achievements for main game and DLC
[*] Added game part select menu from start (This lets you adjust options and then choose to either start the game from the start or from the Epilogue)
[*] Added different combat backgrounds (they resemble the actual game now, not painted images)
[*] Characters actually run up and attack each other now in combat
[*] Revamped combat menus
[*] Added combat difficulty options
[*] Made Polina and Lena look different (They used the same art before)
[*] Added talking sounds during dialogue (Can be turned off in Options)
[*] Added black cinematic bars during cutscene events (Can be turned off in Options)
[*] Added dialogue confirmation sound (Can be turned off in Options)
[*] Added an intro section when starting a new game that allows you to change options before game start
[*] Added short in-game tutorial segments where appropriate (Can be turned off in Options)
[*] Added a bust image for whenever Sir Stretchalot talks
[*] Changed time of day at start of game to afternoon so it makes more sense story-wise
[*] Heaps of polish and improvements to cutscenes
[*] Added new music in different cutscenes
[*] Added new battle music
[*] Added boss battle music
[*] Added Polina to final fight like she was supposed to be
[*] Added blue glow to Polina and Lena.
[*] Made SS hold the reigns not like an idiot when he’s riding Horse
[*] Heaps of art fixes
[*] Made the intro title before you enter the inn not be just crap white text. It’s cool now.
[*] Made the underground area look better (it was really basic before. It still is, really, but it got a bit of love)
[*] Re-did all the lighting (it wasn’t very dark underground and the lighting was barely noticeable. It’s better now and the light from torches really stands out and flickers)
[*] Added heaps more lines of dialogue in various cutscenes
[*] Fixed various issues in the writing
[*] Revamped all menus
[*] Various other fixes
[/list]

Now, I'm going to take a day or two off and get back to work on the sequel, which is a fair way along already. If you're following me on Patreon, you will have seen a lot of stuff for that already. If you're not following, go check my Patreon out anyway because there's lots of images and updates about game 2 that are free to view. Patreon link is below.


That's it for now.


Take care and thanks for supporting me!

- Apple

notes.title: Sir Stretchalot 2 + Character Design for Spunky Hottie Elf Mira!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Just wanted to give an update on where things are at. I've been posting more on Patreon and on my Discord. The progress reports are not paid. You can read them for free on there. There's links to my Patreon and Discord server at the bottom of this post.

Quick update on me: I've been out of action with a health issue. I was born with one kidney and it plays up from time to time. It's on the mend now though, which means I've been getting stuck into things really hard.

The sequel to Sir Stretchalot is shaping up to be way bigger and better than the first game. I'm trying to address all the complaints I got (didn't get too many negative reviews though which was awesome).

Here's just some of the new stuff it will include:     
[list]
[*] At least double the amount of hardcore images in the first game. Maybe even triple which would make it 15 images.
  
[*]Longer play time (should be double the length at the very least, if not more). To give you a rough idea: the first episode had about 6000 words of dialogue. The sequel already has almost 4000 and I'm not even out of the first act yet., and I want the middle act to be bigger.
     
[*]Less linear (I'm planning for it to really open up a bit in Act 2. You'll be able to explore and do some things in your own order).
     
[*]Branching dialogue (Probably won't be a ton of this, but I want to experiment with it for this game).
     
[*]More varied gameplay. It's not going to be just a visual novel with basic combat this time. There will still be heaps of story as that's what I'm most interested in, but this time I'm also doing some stuff with stealth, and the combat is going to be more fleshed out. Also, probably going to do some other stuff like basic puzzles and clue finding if I can work it in.
     
[*]Steam achievements. Pretty sure I know how to make these work, but will take some messing around with.
[/list]
Anyway, onto some art previews! I'm going to copy and paste a lot from the Patreon posts for this:

I'm planning there to be 2-3 feature girls in the second Sir Stretchalot game. Here's the first one, an elf named Miranel (Mira for short). Check her out:

[b]AND FINALLY WE COME TO THE FINISHED MIRA DESIGN SKETCH:[/b]
Finally, she's looking like the sexy, spunky elf with attitude that she's supposed to be!
There's going to be a few more details added later which will sell her character even more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39327445/9511d7c47ab325f86855b4b28fcc7f7e3c14671b.png[/img]

[b]AND FINALLY, THE FIRST STEP OF RENDERING:[/b]
With the design finalized, the rendering towards the final image begins! What comes next is probably the longest part, but I think it'll turn out awesome.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39327445/5ced30ee38f61fa855991e85a1d0ad053c69f374.png[/img]

I should be able to show you the finished art for Mira in game within 1-2 days. After that work will begin on the first 18+ illustration for her, which I can't wait for! (keep in mind, finished 18+illustrations will only be available to members on higher tiers on Patreon. I can't show that 18+ stuff here)

Before the bust art gets finished though, I'll have some really cool stuff to show you about how the combat is changing for Sir Stretchalot.

Oh, and by the way, I mentioned in a recent progress post that there's going to be more than just combat this time around. I'll do posts to show you all of the changes in coming weeks.

But that's it for now.


Take care and thanks for supporting me!

- Apple
